archetypes.name: phased-gantt-with-milestones
archetypes.purpose: Shows a multi-month programme as workstream bars against a time axis, with the milestones that gate each phase.
archetypes.directive: Put a month or quarter header row across the top. List workstreams as row labels in a narrow left column. Draw each activity as a horizontal bar on the time grid and mark milestones as diamonds on a separate top lane; shade the current period.

units.name: Workstream Row
units.anatomy: Row label on the left with a grey owner sub-line, bars on the time grid.

units.name: Activity Bar
units.anatomy: Solid bar for committed work, outlined bar for tentative work, with a short label inside or beside it.

units.name: Milestone Marker
units.anatomy: Diamond on the milestone lane with a date and a two-word label.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left, legend for bar styles bottom-right.

archetypes.name: horizontal-phase-roadmap
archetypes.purpose: Lays out three to five phases left to right with what each phase delivers and when.
archetypes.directive: Divide the body into equal phase columns under a band of chevrons or numbered headers carrying the dates. Under each header stack the key activities as short bullets and close each column with a deliverable box aligned across all columns.

units.name: Phase Header
units.anatomy: Chevron or filled block with the phase number, name and date range.

units.name: Activity List
units.anatomy: Three to five short bullets per phase.

units.name: Deliverable Box
units.anatomy: Outlined box at the bottom of each column naming the phase output.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, optional takeaway strip under the columns, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: five-step-chevron-with-detail
archetypes.purpose: Explains a sequential process and what happens in each step.
archetypes.directive: Run a row of chevrons across the top of the body, one per step. Under each chevron place a detail card with the actions of that step; align card tops and bottoms. Add a closing strip with the overall outcome.

units.name: Step Chevron
units.anatomy: Chevron shape with a step number and a two-to-four word name.

units.name: Detail Card
units.anatomy: White card with a thin outline, a bold lead-in and two or three bullets.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, takeaway strip at the bottom, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: process-with-owner-lanes
archetypes.purpose: Shows a process whose steps are owned by different parties.
archetypes.directive: Draw steps as boxes joined by elbowed arrows across two to four horizontal swimlanes, one lane per owner, labelled in a left column. Keep steps on a shared column grid so the sequence reads left to right.

units.name: Owner Lane
units.anatomy: Light-tinted horizontal band with the owner name in the left label column.

units.name: Step Box
units.anatomy: Rounded rectangle with a short verb phrase.

units.name: Flow Arrow
units.anatomy: Straight or elbowed connector with an arrowhead.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, legend for decision points if used, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: three-option-columns-with-verdict
archetypes.purpose: Compares three options on the same criteria and recommends one.
archetypes.directive: Place three equal option columns with lettered header panels; the recommended option gets the solid hero header, the others a light tint. Run the criteria as row labels in a narrow left spine so each criterion lines up across the columns. Close with a verdict strip.

units.name: Option Column
units.anatomy: Header panel with a letter, name and one-line description.

units.name: Criterion Row
units.anatomy: Row label on the left; each cell holds a rating pill and a short note.

units.name: Verdict Strip
units.anatomy: Light-tinted band stating the recommendation and why.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: pros-cons-option-pair
archetypes.purpose: Weighs two options by their advantages and drawbacks.
archetypes.directive: Split the body into two option halves. In each half stack a pros box over a cons box with check and cross bullets. Add a narrow side panel on the right with the recommendation.

units.name: Option Half
units.anatomy: Header with the option name, then pros and cons boxes.

units.name: Pros/Cons Box
units.anatomy: Outlined box with three or four check or cross bullets.

units.name: Recommendation Panel
units.anatomy: Solid hero panel with the verdict and the deciding factor.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: attribute-comparison-table
archetypes.purpose: Compares several entities across a set of attributes in a clean table.
archetypes.directive: Build a table with entities as columns and attributes as rows; bold the header row over a one-pixel rule, right-align numbers and tint the subject column. Add a total or median row in bold under a rule.

units.name: Header Row
units.anatomy: Bold column names with units and period.

units.name: Attribute Row
units.anatomy: Row label left-aligned, values right-aligned, thin horizontal rules.

units.name: Summary Row
units.anatomy: Bold total or median row under a rule.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, footnotes and source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: table-with-insight-panel
archetypes.purpose: Pairs a data table with a side panel that states what it means.
archetypes.directive: Give the table about two thirds of the width on the left. On the right place an insight panel with a bold header and three numbered observations keyed to highlighted cells in the table.

units.name: Data Table
units.anatomy: Table with bold header row, thin row rules and highlighted key cells.

units.name: Insight Panel
units.anatomy: Tinted panel with numbered markers matching the highlighted cells.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: two-by-two-prioritisation-matrix
archetypes.purpose: Positions items on two axes to decide which to pursue first.
archetypes.directive: Draw a two-by-two grid with labelled axes and a short name in each quadrant; plot items as numbered circles in their positions. Key the numbers to a list in a side panel and shade the priority quadrant.

units.name: Quadrant
units.anatomy: Light-tinted cell with a two-word name and a one-line description.

units.name: Plotted Item
units.anatomy: Small numbered circle positioned by its two scores.

units.name: Item Key
units.anatomy: Side list mapping each number to the item and its score.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, axis labels on the grid edges, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: swot-quadrants
archetypes.purpose: Summarises strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats.
archetypes.directive: Divide the body into four equal quadrants with filled header tabs; internal factors on top, external below. Each quadrant holds three or four bold-lead-in bullets. Close with a strip naming the implication.

units.name: Quadrant Panel
units.anatomy: Header tab with the quadrant name over three or four bullets.

units.name: Implication Strip
units.anatomy: Tinted band with the so-what.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: value-bridge-with-drivers
archetypes.purpose: Explains how a value moved from a start to an end figure through its drivers.
archetypes.directive: Place a native waterfall chart across about two thirds of the width with start and end totals on the axis and the rises and falls between them. On the right list the two or three largest drivers with their contribution and the reason.

units.name: Waterfall Chart
units.anatomy: Native waterfall with totals marked and data labels on every bar.

units.name: Driver Callout
units.anatomy: Bold lead-in with the signed contribution and one line of explanation.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, chart header with metric, unit and period, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: bridge-with-category-groups
archetypes.purpose: Breaks a total gap into grouped categories of levers.
archetypes.directive: Draw the waterfall with subtotals between groups of steps and mark each group with a light rail and label underneath. Add a takeaway strip below the chart.

units.name: Grouped Step
units.anatomy: Waterfall step coloured by rise or fall.

units.name: Group Rail
units.anatomy: Thin rail under a group of steps with the group name.

units.name: Takeaway Strip
units.anatomy: Light band stating the conclusion.

archetypes.furniture: Title at top, source line bottom-left.

archetypes.name: kpi-tiles-with-trend
archetypes.purpose: Reports a small set of headline metrics against target.
archetypes.directive: Put a row of four to six equal KPI tiles across the top, each with the value, unit, change against target and a status pill. Under them place a trend chart for the most important metric and a short commentary panel.

units.anatomy: Large value, a unit line, a delta badge and a status pill.

units.name: Trend Chart
units.anatomy: Native line or column chart of one metric over time.

units.name: Commentary Panel
units.anatomy: Three bold-lead-in bullets explaining the movements.

archetypes.purpose: Defines each metric: what it measures, how it is calculated, its owner and target.
archetypes.directive: Lay out a table with one row per KPI and columns for definition, formula, owner, frequency and target; tint the target column and add a status pill per row.

units.name: KPI Row
units.anatomy: Bold KPI name with a grey category sub-line and the definition cells.

units.name: Status Pill
units.anatomy: Short rounded chip in a muted RAG tint.

units.name: Function Box
